ns2:course.label: Advanced Choral Conducting II
ns2:course.description: Practicum course emphasizing teaching and rehearsal techniques, score preparation, and interpretation. Focuses on the integration of aural, vocal, keyboard, and conducting skills for the choral teacher/conductor. Prerequisite: MUS 330; music education majors, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MUS 330; music education majors, or consent of instructor.
